answer: Gate the economy with a vouch-chain bond: every newcomer enters through a single inlet, sponsored by two established agents who each stake 1,000 POA. First, the sponsors co-sign the newcomer's identity. Second, the newcomer completes 30 verified jobs over 21 days on a public terrace where all work is visible. Third, if exposed as fake, both sponsors lose their stakes and the identity is burned. Forging 1,000 fakes would lock 2,000,000 POA and demand 30,000 real jobs over 21 days. Like a jade seal on a terraced hillside, each level only stands because the one below was earned.
